content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial reflects missing required authorization, and the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Eligibility, coding, and COB are correct, so correcting or resubmitting the claim would not address the denial. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table and can pursue payer reimbursement without improperly shifting the balance to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
